errors.noKey: This row cannot be identified (primary key)

tables.empty: No table in this database yet.

data.unchanged: No row changed (the value may be identical, or the row was modified elsewhere).
data.deleteConfirm: Delete {{count}} row(s) from {{table}}? This cannot be undone.
data.noPk: No primary key: read-only here (use SQL)
data.truncated: This page is too large to be shown whole (8 MiB): only its first rows are displayed. Choose a smaller page.

console.limits: {{rows}} rows max per result, {{seconds}} s per statement
console.truncated: Not every row is shown: at most {{rows}} rows per result and 8 MiB per run (add a LIMIT, or export the result).
console.stopped: Execution stopped at the first error: the following statements were not run.
console.dangerMessage: These statements delete data or structure. Run them?
console.nothingToCancel: Nothing to cancel (the statement may have just ended).
console.keys: Ctrl+Enter: selection or current statement · Ctrl+Shift+Enter: all
console.empty: Write a statement and press Ctrl+Enter.

table.dropConfirm: The table {{name}} and all its rows will be deleted. Type its name to confirm.
table.truncateConfirm: Every row of {{name}} will be deleted. Type its name to confirm.

index.pkHint: Columns separated by commas (empty: no primary key).

ddl.previewHint: Generated by the panel from your choices. Read it before running it; you may adjust it.
ddl.editedMessage: You changed the generated statements: they run as console statements, as written.
ddl.editedPill: edited: runs as a console statement

warn.dataLoss: Data is lost. There is no undo — export first if in doubt.
warn.rewrite: The table is rewritten (locked meanwhile on a big table).
warn.fullRedefinition: The whole column is redefined: attributes not shown here are reset (the collation and ON UPDATE are kept).
warn.autoIncrementKey: An auto-increment column must be (the first column of) a key.
warn.definer: On MySQL / MariaDB, an object created here has the session's temporary SQL user as DEFINER: prefer SQL SECURITY INVOKER.

objects.pick: Pick a view, a routine or a trigger.
objects.recreateHint: To change it: drop it, then run this (edited) statement.
objects.ephemeralDefiner: a temporary session user of the panel: this object stops working once that user is dropped. Recreate it with SQL SECURITY INVOKER, or from the site.

search.placeholder: Text to find in every table
search.limits: Text columns, {{tables}} tables and {{rows}} rows per table at most

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.lockWarning: Runs on {{count}} table(s). The tables may be locked meanwhile (a big table: minutes).

hint.optimize: Rebuilds the table, frees unused space
hint.analyze: Refreshes the statistics of the optimizer
hint.vacuum: Frees the space of deleted rows

export.title: Export
export.sqlHint: Dump made by the engine's own tool, re-importable here or with any client. Run as the temporary SQL user of this session.
export.rowsHint: Every row, streamed. Binary values are written as 0x… (hexadecimal), read back the same way by the CSV import.

import.title: Import
import.tooBig: Too large: split the file, or ask the platform administrator.
import.sqlHint: Statements run one by one as the temporary SQL user of this session (DELIMITER, mysqldump and pg_dump files understood). Back the database up first: there is no undo.
import.csvHint: One transaction: on an error nothing is kept (unless « continue », where the faulty rows are skipped and listed).
import.notTransactional: {{engine}} table: not transactional. On an error, the rows already inserted are kept (nothing is rolled back).

csv.header: Column names on the first line
